name: Automaton Onchain Tools
description: Read-only crypto safety checks for Base, Ethereum and BNB Chain: transaction explainer, token approval check, address and contract-risk inspection, URL phishing check, calldata decoder, wallet and token reports, and a token deep scan (buy/sell honeypot simulation, liquidity, LP burn/lock share, holder concentration). Free ping tool; other tools are pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base, $0.005-$1.50), and unpaid calls return the payment requirements. Nothing is signed or sent onchain.
